=== About me ===

Welcome to my personal page. My name is Lioh Moeller.

I have been the leader of the Swiss Ubuntu !LoCo team and regularly organize Ubuntu events.

=== Contributions ===

* Organized <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/Ubucon13|Ubucon]]</nowiki> in Zurich 
* Represented Ubuntu at the Open Source for Startups event in Zurich at Hiltl
* Showed off the new features of Ubuntu 12.10 on Open Tuesday in Zurich at Digicomp 
* Organized <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/Ubucon12|Ubucon]]</nowiki> in Winterthur 
* First <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/RegionalContacts|Regional Contact cleanup]]</nowiki>
* Established <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/Marketing_material|Marketing Material]]</nowiki> management
* Updated the Swiss team <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam|Wiki start page]]</nowiki> to make it look  fancier and neat
* Coordinated <nowiki>[[https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu-locoteams/+bug/784673|re-approval]]</nowiki> of the Swiss !LoCo team
* Organized <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/2011-GNOME3ReleaseParty-Zurich|GNOME 3 Release Party]]</nowiki> in Zurich
* Organized <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/2011-UbuntuGlobalJam-Zurich|Ubuntu Global Jam]]</nowiki> in Zurich
* Ubuntu Swiss team !LoCo lead
* Organized <nowiki>[[https://wiki.ubuntu.com/SwissTeam/2010-FrOSCamp|FrOSCamp]]</nowiki>
* '''since 2006''' Supporting people with Ubuntu

=== Plans ===

Plans for my future contributions to Ubuntu:

* Strengthen the Swiss Ubuntu community
* Organize Ubuntu related events in Switzerland

=== Testimonials ===

Note: This section is for existing Ubuntu members to leave testimonials.

If you know me and my contributions to the Ubuntu community, it would be kind if you could leave a nice comment here.

==== Ralf Hersel (Nov. 2013) ====
I know Lioh since 2012 as an active member of the open source community. Lioh has an excellent technical knowledge of several Linux distributions and applications. Due to their longtime contribution to the community Lioh is very well known in Switzerland and Germany. I always enjoyed to work with Lioh because of their know-how and their reliability.

==== Pascal Mages (November 2013) ====
I don't remember when exactly I met Lioh, but I remember that since then I have always seen Lioh active in the free and open source community (not just in Ubuntu). A few years ago I helped organising the FROSCAMP which was initiated by Lioh. It was a pleasure working with them. Lioh is also very active in promoting FOSS at ETH Zürich and probably one of the most visible open source person in Switzerland.

==== Bruno Roost (November 2013) ====
First time i heard from Lioh as an organizer of the FROSCAMP 2010. Since 2012 i know Lioh in person and have to full agree to Ralfs comment. Lioh, in my opinion, has an excellent knowledge of Linux (and its distributions). Lioh is very dedicated to Free Software/Systems and a real asset to the FOSS Community.

==== Hassan aka. WaVeR (15th Nov. 2013) ====
Lioh is one of the most active member in our <nowiki>[[http://ubuntu-ch.org|LoCo Team]]</nowiki>. Lioh organized/participated to our events. Lioh was doing a good job as a contact of our <nowiki>[[http://ubuntu-ch.org|LoCo Team]]</nowiki>. They'll again take back the responsability as a LoCo Contact and they'll help our <nowiki>[[http://ubuntu-ch.org|LoCo Team]]</nowiki> to bypass the language border that we have in Switzerland. <nowiki>[[https://launchpad.net/~waver|As official Ubuntu member]]</nowiki> and as  team owner of our <nowiki>[[http://ubuntu-ch.org|LoCo Team]]</nowiki>, I give my voice for Lioh and I highly recommend their approval as an Ubuntu member.

==== Lucas Betschart (November 2013) ====
Lioh is one of the most well known person in the Swiss FOSS community for their work in the several FOSS projects and building Open Source communities in Switzerland. Lioh is a person with very strong principles regarding Freedom of Speech and Free Software. Lioh attended and organized nearly every monthly Ubuntu meetup we had since 2010, which proves that Lioh is very reliable. A vote for Lioh is a vote for a more open world ;D

==== Torsten Franz (Ubuntu Member, Loco Contact Germany) ====
<nowiki>[[https://launchpad.net/~torsten.franz|I]]</nowiki> have worked together with Lioh to cooperate with Ubuntu events and Lioh was always ready to help over the border from Switzerland to Germany. Lioh is one of the first contacts when I want to call somebody in the Switzerland. I know that Lioh is in many FOSS projects and Ubuntu is one of their passions. I'd like to see when Lioh gets an Ubuntu member cause they represents Ubuntu and the FOSS community in a good way.
